terms.seniorPremium: Varies by tenure (see the card); bank states: "Senior Citizen rates are applicable only for Domestic" [deposits] — not NRE/NRO
terms.prematurePenalty: 0.75% for tenure ≤181 days, 1.00% for ≥182 days on deposits <₹5 crore (w.e.f. 3 Nov 2023); flat 0.25% on deposits ≥₹5 crore; nil for senior citizens booked/renewed on/after 16 May 2022 and for staff on/after 10 May 2021
other: Interest for a monthly payout option is discounted from the standard rate.
